title: Analytically controlled single-reservoir Ribasim surrogate
purpose: Create a deterministic research and verification harness for surface-water storage, level, hydrologically forced groundwater exchange, irrigation allocation and shortage before coupling to real Ribasim.
scope: one surface-water reservoir with linear volume-stage relation
groundwater infiltration out of surface water as a mandatory physical flux
irrigation request as a management withdrawal that may be curtailed
explicit reserve/dead-storage constraint for management allocation
priority_contract: mandatory hydrological exchange is evaluated before discretionary irrigation allocation
irrigation delivery may be reduced to protect the configured management reserve
mandatory groundwater infiltration is not silently reduced to satisfy irrigation
if mandatory hydrological outflow exceeds physically available water, the candidate step fails closed
transaction_contract: planning a step does not mutate committed state
a candidate is bound to the committed revision from which it was prepared

experiments.E1: no-conflict full irrigation delivery with exact mass closure
experiments.E2: late conflict: start-of-step volume appears sufficient for irrigation, but mandatory infiltration creates shortage
experiments.E3: management reserve curtails irrigation while hydrological flux remains uncurtailed
experiments.E4: physically infeasible mandatory infiltration fails closed with zero committed-state mutation
experiments.E6: linear stage-volume mapping is exactly invertible

forbidden: no claim that the surrogate reproduces Ribasim network routing or allocation semantics
no silent hydrological-flux curtailment to make the balance feasible
